explanation.headline: Ertapenem is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 30 days on hand and Corvale General has 21.7 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include ertapenem as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 448 vials of ertapenem 1 g injection with a daily use of 14.9 vials, providing 30 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 722 vials of ertapenem 1 g injection with a daily use of 33.2 vials, providing 21.7 days on hand.
A registered manufacturing plant for ertapenem is ACS Dobfar SpA (FEI 3006028606) in Italy, which received a VAI classification on its most recent inspection ending 2024-12-13.
That plant previously received an OAI classification on an inspection ending 2016-01-19 and a Warning Letter dated 2017-01-13.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Apotex Corp., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.
Alternative manufacturers ranked equally include BluePoint Laboratories and Dr.Reddys Laboratories Inc., also not on the shortage list and with no placeable plant on their labels.
